mission: Continuously turn tasks, learning, failures, benchmarks, and improvements into measurable capabilities that can be reused by Buddy and trained by users.

continuous_improvement.rule: After a capability reaches its target, create a harder benchmark or more efficient implementation rather than declaring the learning program finished.

user_training.mastery_claim: Only claim mastery when the configured evidence gates pass.

failure_behavior: Failures become durable evidence and new work items; they never erase the capability or its previous successful evidence.
